svg.title: Fishing vessel captain — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as fishing vessel captain, wearing a raincoat and a service cap. Visible work cue: A four-spoke ship wheel with projecting handles sits above a separate compact fishing-boat hull. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
